purpose: Data-only diagnosis after both frozen visual candidates failed; no new appearance candidate.

cases.hypothesis: Determine whether the previously rejected frozen B field reaches the preselected broad light region.
limitations: Engineering thresholds are not physiological measurements or human visibility thresholds.
One fixed native static view; no motion or multi-person conclusion.

Numerator and denominator are resolved separately AFTER per-fragment indicator*ownership. Quantization and MSAA material boundaries limit precision; do not multiply decoded categories by resolved ownership.
Coverage and normal response cannot grant aesthetic acceptance.
Only the frozen B branch is diagnosed. No amplitude or shape changes are authorized by the result.
